To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
human adenovirus infections are common in adults with acute lower respiratory tract infections in China.
HAdV species were detected in 0.8% of adult ARTI cases in China, with HAdV-14, HAdV-2, and HAdV-E4 being the most frequently detected species.
the prevalence of HAdVs in adult ARTIs in China is low, with species B and E HAdVs being the most prevalent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the detection and characterization of HAdV species associated with ARTIs in China.
the epidemiology of HAdV in adult ARTI in China.
the epidemiology of HAdV in adults with ARTI and the molecular epidemiology of Hadenovirus species and serotypes in China.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HAdVs were associated with ARTIs among Chinese adults.
HAdVs are important etiological agents of respiratory tract infections in children and adults in China, and that HAdV-14, -3, and -4 are the predominant HAdVs causing ARTI in adults in China.
the most prevalent HAdV species in adults in China is species B, and that HAdV-14 is the most prevalent serotype.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the detection of HAdV in adults with acute upper respiratory tract infection is low in China.
the HAdV-1 and HAdV-B serotypes were the most common in adults with acute lower respiratory tract infection (ALRTI) in China.
HAdV species C, E, B, and B, HAdV-1 and HAdV 3, HAdV 4, HAdV7 and HAdV14 are the major HAdV species/serotype in adults in China.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the detection rate of human adenovirus in adults with respiratory infection is 0.8%.
the most common species of HAdV associated with adult ARTIs in China are species B and E, and that HAdV-14, -3, -11, -4, and -7 are the most prevalent serotypes.
HAdVs are common pathogens of ARTIs in adults in China.
